root.label: Ariya Paige dies after being left in hot car

events.label: Ariya Paige dies after being left in hot car

slots.name: hot car deaths
slots.sentence: More than 650 children in the US have died after being accidentally left in hot cars since 1990, when the rise of airbags prompted parents and caregivers to put young children in the back seat, according to Kids and Car Safety.

slots.name: felony murder cases
slots.sentence: Amber Rollins, the executive director of Kids and Car Safety, told HuffPost she was aware of fewer than 10 cases in which the responsible adult was charged with felony murder after accidentally leaving a child in a car.

slots.name: date of death
slots.sentence: In July 2023, while babysitting four children from two different families, 46-year-old Rhonda Jewell forgot 10-month-old Ariya Paige was in the back of her car, and went inside to care for the other kids.

slots.name: cause of death
slots.sentence: Strapped into her carseat in the Florida summer heat, Ariya died of hyperthermia before Jewell realized her mistake.

slots.name: prison sentence
slots.sentence: She was sentenced to 17 years in prison.
